data.body: Implemented and landed Gerrit change 2818 (merged as cca18d7d8c5e3). Recorded diff applied cleanly to current main with no code adaptation beyond the planned docs/help wording. RED test tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_update_stale_drains_while_an_admitted_mechanism_stands failed on unmodified main at rc == 0; after the fix, tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py passed (35 passed), make lint passed, the repo-isolation test passed with GIT_CONFIG_* unset, and make verify passed with GIT_CONFIG_* unset and TMPDIR outside the checkout. .github/mechanism-baseline.json remained unchanged.
